label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is user-controllable parameter name from request.getParameterNames(). The ternary condition (7*42)-106=188>200 evaluates to false, so bar=param (user input). No HTML encoding applied before writing to response.getWriter(). This allows attackers to inject arbitrary JavaScript via URL parameters.

evidence.note: User parameter flows through loop to bar variable, then to writer without sanitization
